change:
v1.2
 - Implements the standard `IProposal` interface (`createProposal`, `hasSucceeded`, `canExecute`, `customProposalParamsABI`; `execute` is not supported: proposals execute when created).
 - `initialize` receives a `TargetConfig`, so actions can be forwarded to a target other than the DAO.
 - The admin is advertised as the DAO member through `IMembership`.

prepareInstallation.description: The information required for the installation.

inputs.name: admin
inputs.description: The account receiving `EXECUTE_PROPOSAL_PERMISSION` on the plugin, so that it can execute actions on the DAO through it.

components.name: target
components.description: The target contract to which actions will be forwarded to for execution. Use the zero address to target the DAO.

components.name: operation
components.description: The operation type (0 = call, 1 = delegatecall) used to forward actions to the target.

prepareUninstallation.description: No input is required for the uninstallation.
